subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Students were surprised that invention could be shared instead of sold privately.”?
options: Her science teacher explained light pollution.
The teacher explained that websites can disappear quickly.
Then the teacher explained that small kindness also counted.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Her science teacher explained light pollution.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The teacher explained that websites can disappear quickly.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Then the teacher explained that small kindness also counted.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Students were surprised that invention could be shared instead of sold privately. Their teacher explained open-source work.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Students were surprised that invention could be shared instead of sold privately. Their teacher explained open-source work.」，答案為「Their teacher explained open-source work.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Their teacher explained open-source work.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
